assumptions: USD and UTC are adapter conventions; the source does not supply a timezone.
User + Card scopes history. Positive purchases only; original source values and labels are preserved.
Blank Errors? is treated as completed; other values as failed attempts.
History starts with the supplied file. No hidden warmup or merchant-fraud feedback is added.
Is Fraud? is used only to compare outcomes, never as a model input.
Card IDs are not devices. Missing graph context is explicitly unknown.
